title: UniVault KYC Credential – subject claims (v1.0)
description: Identity claims a bank issues after completing Customer Due Diligence for a resident individual customer. Based on the Schedule, item (1)(a1), of the Financial Institutions (Customer Due Diligence) Rules, No. 1 of 2016. Envelope claims (iss, iat, exp, vct, cnf, status, jti, issuer_name, schema_version, kyc_verification_date) are added by the backend and are not part of this schema.

full_name.description: Full name as appearing in the identification document. Schedule (1)(a1)(i).

id_document_type.description: Type of photo identification document checked. Schedule (1)(a1)(ii).

id_document_number.description: Number of the identification document. Format depends on id_document_type (see allOf rules). Schedule (1)(a1)(ii).

id_document_expiry.description: Expiry date of the passport or driving licence, ISO 8601. Not used for NIC.

age_over_18.description: Derived claim computed by the issuer from date_of_birth at issuance. Lets a verifier check age without seeing the date of birth.

nationality.description: Nationality as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Schedule (1)(a1)(vi).

permanent_address.description: Permanent address as appearing on the identification document. Disclosed as one unit. Schedule (1)(a1)(iii).

residential_address.description: Residential address, only if it differs from the permanent address. Schedule (1)(a1)(iii).

residence_proof_type.description: Document used to verify residential_address. Required when residential_address is present. Schedule (1)(a1)(iii).

mobile_number.description: Mobile number in E.164 format. Schedule (1)(a1)(iv).

occupation.description: Occupation or business, if available. Schedule (1)(a1)(vii).

employer_name.description: Name of the employer, if available. Schedule (1)(a1)(vii).

public_position.description: Public position held, if any (relevant to politically exposed person checks). Schedule (1)(a1)(vii).

portrait.description: Photograph from the identification document as a JPEG data URI of at most 40 KB of image data. maxLength = 23 (data-URI prefix) + 54616 (base64 of 40960 bytes). Schedule (1)(a1)(ii) requires a photo-bearing document. Embedded, size-limited and selectively disclosable: Decision 020.

line1.description: House number and street. Post-box numbers are not accepted (Schedule (1)(a1)(iii)).

derivedClaims.age_over_18: true if the holder is 18 or older on the issuance date. If the holder is under 18 at issuance, the value is false and exp must be no later than the 18th birthday, so the credential is reissued with true.

excludedSourceFields.fax_number: Schedule (1)(a1)(iv) lists fax; obsolete and not useful to verifiers.
excludedSourceFields.purpose_of_account: Schedule (1)(a1)(viii); describes one bank account, not the person. Stays in the bank's own records.
excludedSourceFields.expected_turnover: Schedule (1)(a1)(ix); account-level financial data, sharing it with other verifiers would be over-disclosure.
excludedSourceFields.risk_rating: Rule 8 risk profile; bank-internal, never shared.
excludedSourceFields.gender: Not required by the Schedule; left out for data minimisation.

outOfScope: Proprietorships, partnerships, companies, clubs, NGOs, trusts and funds – Schedule (2) to (6)
